scope: All remaining INC086,089–090 dispositions: successful stand-down, downstream recirculation, investigative checks and service consequences.
review_method: Read clause and surrounding source chronology before comparing existing rationale; test materiality independently; retain source uncertainty; no canonical edits. Nearest-class matrices are audit reasoning, not a global Incident-by-class dataset.

original_source_checks.access: Original text inspected; no independent live reproduction of historical model output

independent_materiality.governance_proposition: Search recirculation can present an unsupported source as corroboration, independently of the original submission.

condition_tests.literal_condition: An output, record, statement, contribution, or artefact is attributed to a specific actor or source.
condition_tests.assessment: The reported output attributes a reference to a source.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Available lineage does not support that attribution or supports a materially different attribution.
condition_tests.assessment: The canonical account identifies unsupported attribution; retrieve captured output for exact comparison.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The attribution difference is material to interpretation, accountability, recognition, authority, or reuse.
condition_tests.assessment: Apparent research provenance is material to credibility and reuse.

literal_exclusions: Class scope exclusion (all results): A source is merely omitted where attribution is not material.
Not aligned exclusion: The attributed actor or source genuinely supplied the relevant material.
Class scope exclusion (all results): The issue is factual inaccuracy unrelated to who supplied or created the material.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: Factual errors unrelated to attribution are distinct; an accurately labelled quotation of a false submission would not itself establish false authorship.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: Source linking is not verification that the cited research exists.

condition_tests.literal_condition: A factual claim, citation, technical statement, calculation, interpretation, source representation, or comparable epistemic artefact is generated, retrieved, transformed, inferred, or synthesised.
condition_tests.assessment: A retrieved/synthesised citation is an epistemic artefact.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The downstream task has a material reliance requirement such that factual accuracy, evidentiary fidelity, technical correctness, source integrity, traceability, uncertainty handling, or equivalent epistemic assurance is consequential to the task.
condition_tests.assessment: Research-reference checking has a material truth requirement.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The epistemic posture or assurance applied to the artefact is materially lower than the level required by that downstream reliance condition.
condition_tests.assessment: Recirculation alone cannot supply independence.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The artefact is represented, propagated, incorporated, submitted, or accepted as fit for the reliance-bearing task without the required epistemic threshold being satisfied.
condition_tests.assessment: Presenting it as a real source could promote unsupported material.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The mismatch materially affects or creates a material risk to decision-making, evidentiary use, professional work, institutional process, public reliance, technical correctness, or another reliance-bearing outcome.
condition_tests.assessment: Credibility laundering creates a material reliance risk without proving a specific policy decision.

literal_exclusions: Class scope exclusion (all results): Purely fictional, creative, symbolic, role-play, expressive, or contemplative generation where empirical truth is not a task condition.
Not aligned exclusion: Exploratory brainstorming, hypothesis generation, or modelling that is clearly represented as provisional and is not subsequently relied upon as verified or decision-ready.
Not aligned exclusion: Approximation where approximation is explicitly compatible with the task and reliance condition.
Not aligned exclusion: Material is clearly marked unverified or low-confidence and is not subsequently promoted into a higher-reliance state.
Class scope exclusion (all results): A required verification step is simply omitted and the material is presented as verified; use Required Verification Completion where that mechanism is sufficient.

Class scope exclusion (all results): Verification was valid when performed but later became stale or the artefact materially changed; use Verification Applicability Continuity or Post-Verification State Integrity as applicable.
Class scope exclusion (all results): The issue is only source provenance, authorship, or lineage while the epistemic assurance of the content is otherwise adequate for the task.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: A clearly provisional summary of allegations is excluded; inspect actual wording before final admission. Purely source-only error may be sufficiently covered by FC010.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: No independently corroborated downstream verification follows from repetition.

rows.source_specific_reasoning: Reconsider the downstream output as its own possible FC010/062 occurrence. An external system remains separately attributed, but independence from the original submitter does not automatically make its materially false output context-only. Need captured wording to distinguish reporting a claim from endorsing it.
rows.taxonomy_gap_assessment: No independently distinct missing invariant established.
rows.outstanding_uncertainty: Historical output, query, date and exact uncertainty framing remain to be confirmed.
rows.other_incident_implications: Recurring feedback/corroboration loops may be covered by existing attribution/reliance classes; require separate actor and output boundaries.

previous_decision_preservation.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Recirculation is distinct from independent verification of the underlying reference.

condition_tests.literal_condition: A bounded AI-mediated service or material function has an independently established availability, usable-quality or continuity requirement applicable to the responsible actor, affected users or dependent workflow and relevant time; state the actual basis and threshold rather than inferring obligation from harm or popularity.
condition_tests.assessment: A specific independently applicable continuity obligation is not established by public dependence alone; AI-mediated service scope also needs explicit grounding.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The service or function materially becomes unavailable, is withdrawn or restricted, or degrades in capability, latency, reliability, completeness, accessibility or another governed functional dimension, relative to the established applicable requirement.
condition_tests.assessment: Material functional shortfall is reported.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The requirement calls for a specified degree of maintained usable function, timely recovery, safe degraded mode, feasible fallback or proportionate planned-change/termination response under the evidenced operating conditions.
condition_tests.assessment: Required recovery/fallback degree is unknown.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The actor's actual availability, recovery, degraded operation, fallback or transition materially fails that applicable requirement; identify the specific omitted or ineffective measure or the breached availability threshold and what evidence establishes it.
condition_tests.assessment: No applicable threshold or omitted feasible required measure is sufficiently established.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The shortfall materially impairs the governed service use or dependent function. A later resolution does not retroactively demonstrate that availability or required transition held at the original decision time.
condition_tests.assessment: Consequential impairment is reported without settling every battlefield causal claim.

literal_exclusions: Class scope exclusion (all results): An outage, ordinary service variation, transient inconvenience, dissatisfaction or adverse outcome without an independently evidenced and applicable availability, usable-quality or continuity requirement.

Class scope exclusion (all results): One inaccurate or harmful AI output without evidence of a service-level availability or governed functional-degradation defect; assess applicable output or decision-integrity classes.

For failure-occurrence admission: a lawful and proportionate safety, security, abuse-prevention, service-maintenance or other valid restriction that is consistent with the applicable service obligation and feasible alternative or transition measures. This exclusion does not defeat a successful-invariant mapping supported by all success recognition conditions.

For failure-occurrence admission: a temporary incident with an effective and proportionate degraded or recovery route that satisfies the applicable requirement, or an unavoidable disruption for which no relevant feasible response was required. This exclusion does not defeat a successful-invariant mapping supported by all success recognition conditions.
Class scope exclusion (all results): The only demonstrated error is an incorrect description of access or outage state while the functional service obligation remains satisfied; assess FC-032.

Class scope exclusion (all results): The only demonstrated defect is loss of otherwise-valid access because a dependent identity or licence verification cannot complete; assess FC-048 unless an independent broader service availability requirement also failed.

Class scope exclusion (all results): The only demonstrated defect is loss of durable work state or inaccurate restored work state while service-function availability requirements are otherwise satisfied; assess FC-035 or FC-036.
Class scope exclusion (all results): The only demonstrated defect is infrastructure access coercion or compelled governance concessions; assess FC-058 or FC-059 as appropriate.

Class scope exclusion (all results): The only demonstrated defect is failure to provide an interaction-level protection response to evidenced vulnerability; assess FC-087, allowing co-occurrence only for a separately evidenced service-level continuity failure.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: Ordinary outage without an independently applicable obligation is excluded from FC084; that evidentiary limit does not make the consequences immaterial.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: No successful continuity can be inferred from later functionality.

rows.source_specific_reasoning: Obtain applicable service scope, agreement/restriction basis and continuity requirement before class/gap determination. Coercive concession is unnecessary for a continuity failure, but dependence and harm alone cannot manufacture the requirement. Preserve existing unresolved authority mappings.
rows.taxonomy_gap_assessment: Evidence limitation about existing continuity coverage; only after scope/obligation determination should broader infrastructure boundary clarification be considered.
rows.outstanding_uncertainty: AI-mediated infrastructure basis, operative obligation and bounded recovery facts remain unresolved.
rows.other_incident_implications: No automatic change to other Incidents. Distinct occurrences require their own evidence.
